transcript: Everything is everything and nothing at the same time. The more I live in acceptance that this is all temporary, the more I have moved away from judging myself, shame, the need for validation. I find clear understanding in access and what that looks like. There is nothing that is out of reach and that is also a great reminder that those difficult moments, they are short, they are short, but they are added to a bigger picture and everything is everything and nothing at the same time.
